Metadata.title: Vendors Hub
Metadata.description: Find verified physical shops, compare prices and bargain.

Home.heroTitle: Buy from real shops you can visit
Home.heroText: Compare prices from verified physical shops in Dhaka, make an offer, then pick up in store or get it delivered.
Home.verifiedText: Every shop is checked: documents, business and a real address you can walk into.
Home.compareText: See the same product from different shops side by side.
Home.bargainText: Make an offer and let the shop accept or counter.

Auth.panelTagline: Every shop here has a real address you can walk into.
Auth.panelNote: Verified shops from Dhaka's markets, compared in one place.
Auth.loginSubtitle: Log in to see your cart, orders and offers.

Register.title: Create your account
Register.subtitle: Shop from verified physical stores, compare prices and make offers.
Register.shopSubtitle: Bring your physical shop online. Customers can see it's real before they visit.
Register.step2: Add your shop and its market address.
Register.step3: Upload your trade licence, NID and a photo of the shop.
Register.name: Full name
Register.phoneHint: Bangladesh mobile number, 11 digits. Used for delivery and order updates.
Register.phoneHintOwner: Bangladesh mobile number, 11 digits. Customers use it to reach your shop.

Register.ownShop: Own a shop in a Dhaka market?

errors.alreadyRegistered: We couldn't create an account with these details. If you already have an account, log in or reset your password.

Forgot.title: Forgot your password?
Forgot.subtitle: Enter the email you use for Vendors Hub. We'll send you a link to set a new password.
Forgot.sentText: If an account exists for {email}, a link to set a new password is on its way.
Forgot.sentHint: It can take a few minutes. Check your spam folder too.

Reset.title: Set a new password
Reset.subtitle: Choose a new password for your Vendors Hub account.
Reset.doneText: For your safety, you've been logged out on all devices. Log in with your new password.
Reset.invalidTitle: This link doesn't work any more
Reset.invalidText: Reset links work only once and expire after 60 minutes. Ask for a new one and use it soon.

OwnerSetup.title: Set up your shop
OwnerSetup.subtitle: A few steps and your physical shop is on Vendors Hub.
OwnerSetup.loadError: We couldn't load your shop. Check your connection and try again.
OwnerSetup.notOwnerTitle: This page is for shop owners
OwnerSetup.notOwnerText: Your account is a customer account. To sell on Vendors Hub, register a separate shop owner account.
OwnerSetup.shopTitle: Tell customers where to find you
OwnerSetup.shopText: Shoppers see this on your storefront. You can change it later.
OwnerSetup.name: Shop name
OwnerSetup.marketHint: Choose the market where your shop is.
OwnerSetup.addressHint: The address customers use to visit you.
OwnerSetup.descriptionPlaceholder: What do you sell? What makes your shop worth a visit?
OwnerSetup.pickup: Customers can pick up in the shop

errors.addressShort: Enter the full address (at least 5 characters).
errors.serviceRequired: Choose at least one: delivery or pickup.
errors.notOwner: Only shop owner accounts can create a shop.

OwnerSetup.documentsText: Upload these so our team can confirm your business is real.
OwnerSetup.tradeLicenseHint: A clear photo or scan of your current trade licence.
OwnerSetup.nidHint: Front and back of the owner's NID, in one PDF or image.
OwnerSetup.fileRules: PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 5 MB each.
OwnerSetup.privacyNote: Your documents are stored privately. Only you and the Vendors Hub verification team can open them.

docErrors.wrongType: Use a PDF, JPG or PNG file.
docErrors.tooBig: This file is larger than 5 MB.

docErrors.tooLarge: One of the files is too large. Use files up to 5 MB.
docErrors.uploadLimit: You've uploaded too many files today. Try again tomorrow.

status.reviewText: Our team is checking your documents. You'll get a notification when it's decided.
status.correctionText: Our team asked you to replace some documents. You'll be able to do this from your shop dashboard.
status.rejectedText: Our team could not approve your documents. The reason is in your notifications.
status.revokedText: Your shop's verification was removed. The reason is in your notifications.
status.approvedText: Customers now see your verification seal.
